verdict.rationale: Netlify's own marketing directly claims the story's capability: "Manage access, secrets, and env vars by team" covers team-scoped access control, secrets and environment variables in one place. The evidence is a single one-line claim, so depth and real-world behavior are unverified. Missing for 10: in-depth docs on team roles and permissions, details of secret and env-var scoping (per-site vs. team-wide, per-context values), API/CLI management of env vars, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
